references.shows: The single F horn side photo shows three rotary levers, the oblique leadpipe and a wide downward bell.
Maker reference for the chosen instrument form and proportions.

silhouette: Round single horn coil with a narrow leadpipe and broad bell opening off to the side.
features: Circular outer wrap and nested open tubing
Three rotary valve levers inside the coil
Slender leadpipe ending in a small mouthpiece
Long bell throat blends into a broad downward flare on the right.
iconFeatures: Round coil joined to a broad downward bell.
avoid: Overlapping tubes that hide the principal bends
Detached or offset mouthpiece and bell
notes: The neutral catalogue photo of the YHR-314II guides the silhouette and visible tube routing. The illustration simplifies overlapping plumbing from the side.

geometry.view: Neutral catalogue side view in playing orientation
geometry.proportions: The upper coil is approximately circular. The bell opens downward beside and below it, with a rim close to the coil diameter.
geometry.partLayout: Carry the outer bow into the bell throat on the right. Angle the mouthpipe up from the left toward the three rotary valves. Seat the nested tuning branches at the valve block.

documentedDimensions.value: 12 mm bore in the rotary-valve section. Use the reference view for bell and coil proportions.
